tagline.zh: 紅旗、馬尾、一通不能等的電話
tagline.en: Red flags, a cauda equina and a call that cannot wait

desc.zh: 早上一台胸腰椎固定，中午一個不能等的馬尾症候群，傍晚一顆變慢的心跳。會陰感覺要問出口，不要假設。
desc.en: A thoracolumbar fixation in the morning, a cauda equina that cannot wait at noon, a slowing heart at dusk. Ask about saddle sensation out loud; never assume.

desc.zh: C 臂正側面、節數確認、MRI 安全問卷。外科醫師數錯一節，你是最後一道防線。
desc.en: C-arm AP and lateral, level counting, the MRI safety questionnaire. When a surgeon miscounts a level, you are the last line of defence.

about.zh: 胸前口袋永遠插著一支反射槌，思考時拿來敲桌子。口頭禪：「問出口，不要假設。」
about.en: A reflex hammer always in his breast pocket, tapped on the desk while thinking. Catchphrase: 'Ask it out loud; never assume.'

about.zh: 昨晚在 ICU 守了陳先生的血壓一整夜。
about.en: Sat on Mr Chen's blood pressure in the ICU all night.

about.zh: 椎弓根螺釘的長度與直徑，她遞之前會再唸一次。
about.en: Reads out the length and diameter of every pedicle screw before she passes it.

about.zh: 運動誘發電位一變，他比任何人先開口。
about.en: When the motor evoked potentials change, he speaks before anyone else.

role.zh: 病人・52 歲鷹架工人

about.zh: 昨天從鷹架摔下，第十二胸椎爆裂性骨折，ASIA C。他問的是：「腳什麼時候會回來？」
about.en: Fell from scaffolding yesterday: T12 burst fracture, ASIA C. His question: 'When do my legs come back?'

about.zh: 背痛三天，今天早上開始兩腿之間麻、尿不出來。他以為是閃到腰。
about.en: Three days of back pain; this morning numbness between the legs and he cannot pass urine. He thought it was a pulled back.

about.zh: ICU 與病房之間跑來跑去，電話一來通常先說「不好意思」。
about.en: Runs between ICU and the ward; her calls usually start with 'sorry to bother you'.

about.zh: 她問病人會陰感覺時從不繞彎。
about.en: Never beats about the bush when asking about saddle sensation.

plain.zh: 劃刀前全隊停下來核對病人、手術與節數。脊椎手術還要在 X 光下再數一次節。
plain.en: Before the incision the whole team stops to confirm patient, operation and level. In spine surgery the level is counted again under X-ray.

plain.zh: 從脊椎後方穿過椎弓根鎖進椎體的螺釘，用來固定不穩定的脊椎。進入點與角度決定安全。
plain.en: A screw passed from the back of the vertebra through its pedicle into the body, used to fix an unstable spine. Entry point and angle decide its safety.

plain.zh: 手術中持續測量神經訊號，訊號一變就提醒外科醫師停下來檢查。
plain.en: Nerve signals measured continuously during surgery; when they change, the surgeon is told to stop and check.

plain.zh: 脊椎受傷的人翻身要像翻一根木頭：頭頸與身體一起動，由頭端的人下口令。
plain.en: Turning a spine-injured person like a log: head, neck and body move as one, on the command of the person at the head.

plain.zh: 脊髓損傷的嚴重度分級，從 A（完全）到 E（正常），依運動與感覺檢查決定。
plain.en: A severity grade for spinal cord injury from A (complete) to E (normal), decided by motor and sensory examination.

plain.zh: 脊髓受傷後血管失去張力、心跳變慢、血壓掉。和失血的休克不同，不能只用灌水解決。
plain.en: After a cord injury the vessels lose their tone, the pulse slows and the pressure drops. Different from blood-loss shock; it is not fixed by fluids alone.

plain.zh: 背痛裡的危險訊號：會陰麻、尿不出來、無力、發燒、癌症病史、嚴重外傷。有紅旗就不是「閃到腰」。
plain.en: Danger signs hidden in back pain: saddle numbness, retention, weakness, fever, a cancer history, major trauma. With a red flag it is not 'a pulled back'.

plain.zh: 腰椎最下面一束神經被壓住：會陰麻、大小便失控、腿無力。以小時計算的急症，要盡快減壓。
plain.en: The bundle of nerves at the bottom of the spine is compressed: saddle numbness, bladder and bowel loss, leg weakness. An emergency counted in hours, needing early decompression.

plain.zh: 坐在馬鞍會碰到的地方——會陰、肛門周圍——感覺變鈍。馬尾症候群最重要的問題，要親口問、親手測。
plain.en: Numbness where a saddle would touch: the perineum and around the anus. The most important question in cauda equina; ask it aloud and test it.

plain.zh: 尿完之後膀胱裡還剩多少，用掃描儀量。尿不乾淨是神經受壓的客觀證據。
plain.en: How much urine stays in the bladder after voiding, measured with a scanner. Incomplete emptying is objective evidence of nerve compression.

plain.zh: 懷疑馬尾症候群時，MRI 不是明天的事，是今天的事。先問清楚身上有沒有金屬。
plain.en: When cauda equina is suspected, the MRI is today's job, not tomorrow's. First ask about metal in the body.

plain.zh: 把壓住神經的東西拿掉：椎間盤、骨頭、腫瘤。越早做，恢復的機會越大。
plain.en: Removing whatever is pressing on the nerves: disc, bone, tumour. The sooner it is done, the better the chance of recovery.

plain.zh: 癌症轉移到脊椎壓住脊髓。背痛加腿無力、癌症病史，要平躺、依醫囑類固醇、一天內 MRI。
plain.en: Cancer spread to the spine pressing on the cord. Back pain, leg weakness and a cancer history mean lie flat, steroids per protocol and an MRI within the day.

text.zh: 脊椎手術的尺。從薦椎往上數節，正面側面各一張，螺釘進去前後都要看。
text.en: The ruler of spine surgery. Count levels up from the sacrum, AP and lateral, before and after every screw.

text.zh: 運動與感覺誘發電位、螺釘的刺激測試。基線在擺位後重新建立。
text.en: Motor and sensory evoked potentials, and stimulation testing of screws. Baselines are re-established after positioning.

text.zh: 三十秒量出殘尿量。馬尾症候群的客觀證據就在這台機器裡。
text.en: Measures the post-void residual in thirty seconds. The objective evidence for cauda equina lives in this machine.

text.zh: 探針、開路器、測深、不同長度直徑的螺釘與連接桿。每一支的尺寸都唸出來。
text.en: Probe, awl, depth gauge, screws of every length and diameter, and the rods. Every size is read aloud.

text.zh: 今天借給你用一天。膝反射、踝反射、肛門反射——還有敲桌子。
text.en: Lent to you for the day. Knee jerk, ankle jerk, anal reflex, and tapping the desk.

text.zh: 心律調節器、金屬碎片、植入物、刺青、懷孕。問完簽名，病人才能進磁場。
text.en: Pacemaker, metal fragments, implants, tattoos, pregnancy. Signed off before anyone enters the magnet.

text.zh: 還有一點感覺、還尿得出一些，叫不完全型，減壓最有機會救回功能。等到完全沒感覺，就晚了。
text.en: Some sensation left and some voiding possible is 'incomplete': decompression has the best chance of saving function. Once sensation is gone, it is late.

text.zh: 一百個背痛裡有九十九個會自己好，紅旗是為了找那一個。問題要問出口，不要假設。
text.en: Ninety-nine of a hundred backs get better on their own; red flags exist to find the one that will not. Ask the questions out loud; never assume.

note.zh: 交班：胸腰椎固定與一夜的血壓
note.en: Handover: a thoracolumbar fixation and a night of blood pressure

guide.en: Find Dr Lu for handover

lines.zh: 早。陳先生，52 歲，昨天鷹架摔下，T12 爆裂性骨折，ASIA C。夜裡心跳慢、血壓低，神經性休克，依醫囑撐住了。
lines.en: Morning. Mr Chen, 52, fell from scaffolding yesterday, T12 burst fracture, ASIA C. Slow pulse and low pressure overnight, neurogenic shock, held per protocol.

lines.zh: 第一台就是他：後路椎弓根螺釘固定加減壓。急診說有個背痛的可能會打來。
lines.en: He's first: posterior pedicle screw fixation and decompression. The ER says a back pain may call.

lines.zh: 翻身都用翻身法？
lines.en: Every turn by log roll?

lines.zh: 每一次。范主治把反射槌留在桌上給你。
lines.en: Every one. Dr Fan left his reflex hammer on the desk for you.

lines.zh: 白板：08:00 T12 固定＋減壓（陳先生）。ICU：血壓目標依醫囑。
lines.en: Whiteboard: 08:00 T12 fixation + decompression (Mr Chen). ICU: blood pressure target per protocol.

guide.zh: 和范主治在床邊做 ASIA 檢查
guide.en: Bedside ASIA exam with Dr Fan

lines.zh: 早。ASIA 分級要怎麼定？檢查從哪裡開始？
lines.en: Morning. How is the ASIA grade decided? Where does the examination start?

lines.zh: 肌力十組、感覺二十八個皮節、最後會陰：肛門感覺與自主收縮。問出口，不要假設。
lines.en: Ten motor groups, twenty-eight sensory dermatomes, then the perineum: anal sensation and voluntary contraction. Ask it out loud; never assume.

lines.zh: 醫師，腳還是不太聽話。什麼時候會回來？
lines.en: Doctor, the legs still won't listen. When do they come back?

lines.zh: 陳先生，您還有感覺、還能動一點，這是不完全損傷，有恢復的空間。今天先把脊椎固定、把壓力拿掉。
lines.en: Mr Chen, you still have sensation and some movement: that is an incomplete injury, with room to recover. Today we fix the spine and take the pressure off.

guide.en: Time-out and log roll to prone

lines.zh: 時間暫停。陳先生，T12 後路椎弓根螺釘固定加減壓，過敏無，抗生素依醫囑。
lines.en: Time-out. Mr Chen, T12 posterior pedicle screw fixation and decompression, no allergies, antibiotics per protocol.

lines.zh: 翻成俯臥。脊椎不穩定的人翻身，誰下口令？
lines.en: Turn him prone. Who gives the command when an unstable spine is turned?

lines.zh: 頭端控制頸椎的人。其他人只聽口令。
lines.en: The person at the head controlling the neck. Everyone else only follows the command.

q.en: The correct steps of a log roll

steps.zh: 頭端一人固定頸椎並指揮
steps.en: One person at the head holds the neck and leads

steps.zh: 其他人就位、手放肩髖膝
steps.en: Others in place, hands at shoulder, hip, knee

post.zh: 俯臥後基線重建：運動與感覺誘發電位都在。
post.en: Baselines re-established prone: motor and sensory potentials present.

guide.en: Position the C-arm and count levels

lines.zh: 側面先來，從薦椎往上數到 T12。正面確認椎弓根的「貓頭鷹眼」。
lines.en: Lateral first, counting up from the sacrum to T12. AP to confirm the pedicles' 'owl eyes'.

lines.zh: 我數到 T12。你呢？
lines.en: I count T12. You?

lines.zh: T12。兩個人數一樣才釘。鉛衣、護頸，大家都穿好了。
lines.en: T12. Two people agreeing before any screw. Lead and thyroid collars on, everyone.

q.zh: 點一下 C 臂，把它推到能拍 T12 正側面的位置
q.en: Tap the C-arm and bring it to where it can image T12 AP and lateral

guide.zh: 椎弓根螺釘：進入點與軌跡
guide.en: Pedicle screws: entry point and trajectory

lines.zh: 進入點：橫突中線與上關節突外緣的交會。軌跡向內、順著椎弓根。探針要感覺四壁都是骨頭。
lines.en: Entry: where the transverse process midline meets the lateral facet. Trajectory medial, along the pedicle. The probe must feel bone on all four walls.

lines.zh: 螺釘，長度與直徑唸給你聽。
lines.en: Screw; reading you the length and diameter.

lines.zh: 螺釘刺激測試，閾值正常。
lines.en: Screw stimulation test: threshold normal.

post.zh: 上下各兩節，連接桿上。減壓：把壓住脊髓的骨片拿掉。
post.en: Two levels above and below, rods on. Decompression: remove the fragment pressing on the cord.

post.zh: 這句話是今天最好聽的一句。
post.en: That is the best sentence of the day.

guide.en: Final AP and lateral

lines.zh: 正面：螺釘都在椎弓根影子裡。側面：長度沒穿出前壁。存檔，兩張都進病歷。
lines.en: AP: every screw inside the pedicle shadow. Lateral: none past the anterior wall. Saved; both go into the notes.

lines.zh: 謝謝。你今天數的那一次，比我的手重要。
lines.en: Thank you. The count you did today mattered more than my hands.

guide.zh: 寫手術紀錄與 ICU 交接
guide.en: Op note and ICU handover

lines.zh: 紀錄：節數、螺釘尺寸與數目、減壓範圍、神經監測結果、出血量、硬膜是否完整。
lines.en: Note: levels, screw sizes and count, extent of decompression, neuromonitoring result, blood loss, dura intact or not.

lines.zh: ICU 交接：血壓目標依醫囑、每小時神經學檢查、翻身法、壓瘡與血栓預防。
lines.en: ICU handover: pressure target per protocol, hourly neuro checks, log roll, pressure-sore and clot prevention.

lines.zh: 還有：他問腳什麼時候回來。寫下你跟他說的話。
lines.en: And: he asked when his legs come back. Write down what you told him.

note.zh: 阿凱：馬尾症候群，MRI 今天做

sub.zh: 38 歲背痛、會陰麻、尿不出來
sub.en: Man of 38: back pain, saddle numbness, cannot pass urine

lines.zh: 脊椎嗎？38 歲倉儲員，背痛三天，今早兩腿之間麻、尿不出來。我直接問了會陰感覺，他說「怪怪的」。
lines.en: Spine? Warehouse worker, 38, three days of back pain, this morning numb between the legs and can't pass urine. I asked about saddle sensation directly; he said 'it feels odd'.

lines.zh: 紅旗徵象兩個以上。先當馬尾症候群。膀胱掃描量殘尿量，我馬上下去。
lines.en: Two red flags or more. Cauda equina until proven otherwise. Bladder scan for a post-void residual; I'm coming down.

lines.zh: 他一直說只是閃到腰。
lines.en: He keeps saying it's just a pulled back.

guide.zh: 急診：會陰檢查與膀胱評估
guide.en: ER: perineal exam and bladder assessment

lines.zh: 醫師，我只是閃到腰，搬貨搬的。
lines.en: Doctor, it's just a pulled back, from lifting.

lines.zh: 阿凱，我要問幾個很直接的問題，然後做檢查。兩腿之間、肛門周圍，感覺和平常一樣嗎？
lines.en: Kai, I'm going to ask some very direct questions and then examine you. Between the legs and around the back passage: does it feel normal?

lines.zh: ……鈍鈍的。而且早上尿不太出來。
lines.en: ...dull. And this morning I couldn't really pee.

lines.zh: 會陰麻木、肛門感覺減退、自主收縮弱、殘尿量很多。不完全型馬尾症候群，今天就要處理。
lines.en: Saddle anaesthesia, reduced anal sensation, weak voluntary contraction, a large residual. Incomplete cauda equina syndrome; it gets dealt with today.

guide.en: MRI safety questionnaire

lines.zh: 阿凱，進 MRI 之前：有沒有心律調節器、金屬碎片、手術植入物、刺青？
lines.en: Kai, before the MRI: any pacemaker, metal fragments, surgical implants, tattoos?

lines.zh: 都沒有。倉庫的堆高機算嗎？
lines.en: None. Does the forklift count?

lines.zh: 不算。簽名，我帶你進去。這台掃描一個小時內要做完。
lines.en: It doesn't. Sign here and I'll take you in. This scan happens within the hour.

guide.en: MRI timing: your decision

lines.zh: 不完全型馬尾症候群，MRI 排什麼時候？
lines.en: Incomplete cauda equina. When is the MRI?

q.zh: 懷疑不完全型馬尾症候群，MRI 什麼時候做？
q.en: Suspected incomplete cauda equina. When is the MRI done?

options.zh: 現在，緊急 MRI，然後直接排手術
options.en: Now: urgent MRI, then straight onto the list

why.zh: 對。不完全型是能救回功能的窗口。等到完全型，窗口就關了。
why.en: Right. 'Incomplete' is the window in which function can be saved. By the time it is complete, the window has closed.

why.zh: 一個晚上可以把不完全型變成完全型。今晚的交班會提到這件事。
why.en: One night can turn incomplete into complete. Tonight's handover will mention this.

options.zh: 先照 X 光再決定

why.zh: X 光看不到椎間盤壓神經。這一步只會浪費時間。
why.en: An X-ray cannot show a disc pressing on nerves. This step only costs time.

note.zh: MRI：大的中央型椎間盤突出
note.en: MRI: a large central disc prolapse

guide.zh: 和范主治看阿凱的 MRI
guide.en: Review Kai's MRI with Dr Fan

lines.zh: 片子上來了。你報。
lines.en: Images are up. You present.

lines.zh: 先矢狀面找哪一節，再軸狀面看椎管剩多少。
lines.en: Sagittal first to find the level, then axial to see how much canal is left.

question.zh: 馬尾症候群的腰椎 MRI 要確認什麼？
question.en: What must the lumbar MRI confirm in cauda equina syndrome?

answer.zh: 哪一節、是不是大的中央型椎間盤突出、椎管被佔據的比例、馬尾神經有沒有被擠成一團、是否不只一節。
answer.en: Which level, whether it is a large central disc prolapse, how much of the canal is occupied, whether the cauda equina roots are crowded together, and whether more than one level is involved.

post.zh: L5–S1 大的中央型突出，椎管幾乎佔滿。幾點開？
post.en: Large central prolapse at L5–S1, canal nearly filled. What time do we operate?

post.zh: 下午第一台。已經跟麻醉和開刀房說了。
post.en: First case this afternoon. Anaesthesia and theatre already know.

post.zh: 去吃飯，十分鐘。反射槌還我——不，你留著。
post.en: Eat, ten minutes. Give me back the hammer. No, keep it.

guide.zh: 時間暫停：節數再數一次
guide.en: Time-out: count the level again

lines.zh: 時間暫停。阿凱，L5–S1 減壓與椎間盤切除，過敏無，抗生素依醫囑。
lines.en: Time-out. Kai, L5–S1 decompression and discectomy, no allergies, antibiotics per protocol.

lines.zh: 俯臥、腹部懸空。切口前 C 臂側面定位，針放在棘突上。
lines.en: Prone, abdomen free. C-arm lateral before the incision, needle on the spinous process.

lines.zh: L5–S1，兩個人數一樣。
lines.en: L5–S1; two people agree.

guide.en: Principles of the decompression

lines.zh: 馬尾的減壓要寬，但硬膜已經被撐得很薄。原則？
lines.en: A cauda equina decompression is wide, but the dura is stretched paper-thin. Principles?

lines.zh: 足夠的骨窗、兩側都看、輕輕牽開硬膜、把突出的椎間盤整塊拿掉、確認神經根鬆了。
lines.en: An adequate bony window, look on both sides, retract the dura gently, remove the prolapsed disc in one piece, confirm the roots are free.

lines.zh: 一大塊椎間盤從硬膜下面出來。被壓扁的硬膜慢慢鼓回來，開始隨呼吸搏動。
lines.en: A large piece of disc comes out from under the dura. The flattened sac slowly fills again and begins to pulse with each breath.

lines.zh: 看到它跳，就可以關了。
lines.en: When you see it pulsing, you may close.

guide.en: Post-op instructions: bladder and perineum

lines.zh: 術後醫囑：留置尿管、每班會陰感覺與肛門張力、下肢肌力、拔尿管後再量殘尿量。
lines.en: Post-op orders: indwelling catheter, saddle sensation and anal tone every shift, leg power, and a post-void residual after the catheter comes out.

lines.zh: 還有一件事要寫：恢復可能要幾個月，膀胱最慢。先跟他說，不要讓他明天失望。
lines.en: One more thing to write: recovery may take months, and the bladder is slowest. Tell him now, so tomorrow does not disappoint him.

note.zh: 神經性休克再現，處理得對

sub.zh: 陳先生心跳慢、血壓掉、人是清醒的
sub.en: Mr Chen: slow pulse, falling pressure, still awake

guide.en: Take the call and go to ICU

lines.zh: 不好意思，醫師。陳先生翻身後心跳越來越慢，血壓往下掉，手腳是溫的，人清醒。
lines.en: Sorry to bother you, doctor. After the turn Mr Chen's pulse keeps slowing and the pressure is dropping; hands and feet warm, he's awake.

lines.zh: 溫的手腳加慢心跳——神經性休克，不是失血。平躺、脊椎對位、通知范主治與麻醉，我到了。
lines.en: Warm limbs with a slow pulse: neurogenic shock, not blood loss. Flat, spine aligned, call Dr Fan and anaesthesia; I'm here.

options.zh: 脊椎對位、依醫囑血壓目標與用藥、排除出血、叫主治
options.en: Spine aligned, pressure target and drugs per protocol, exclude bleeding, call the attending

why.zh: 對。神經性休克要維持灌流到脊髓，用藥依醫囑；同時永遠要排除還有別處在流血。
why.en: Right. Neurogenic shock needs the cord perfused, with drugs per protocol, while bleeding elsewhere is always excluded.

options.zh: 大量輸液直到血壓正常
options.en: Fluids until the pressure is normal

why.zh: 血管張力沒了，灌再多也撐不起來，反而把肺灌滿。
why.en: With no vessel tone, fluids will not hold the pressure up; they fill the lungs instead.

options.en: Sit him up to make him comfortable

why.zh: 剛固定的脊椎、正在掉的血壓，坐起來兩個都會更糟。
why.en: A freshly fixed spine and a falling pressure both get worse sitting up.

guide.en: Report to Dr Fan

lines.zh: 陳先生，翻身後心跳慢、血壓低、四肢溫暖、意識清楚。傷口乾、腹部軟、血色素沒掉。神經性休克。
lines.en: Mr Chen: after turning, slow pulse, low pressure, warm limbs, fully alert. Wound dry, abdomen soft, haemoglobin steady. Neurogenic shock.

lines.zh: 跟失血的休克差在哪裡？
lines.en: How does it differ from haemorrhagic shock?

lines.zh: 失血會心跳快、手腳冷。他剛好相反。所以不是灌水，是依醫囑維持血壓目標，保護脊髓。
lines.en: Blood loss gives a fast pulse and cold limbs. He is the opposite. So not fluids, but a pressure target per protocol to protect the cord.

lines.zh: 對。這個目標要撐幾天，不是幾小時。
lines.en: Right. And that target is held for days, not hours.

note.zh: 交給夜班；師傅的三件事
note.en: Handed to the night team; the mentor's three things

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 陳先生固定加減壓，訊號沒變，傍晚神經性休克依醫囑處理中。阿凱 L5–S1 減壓，術後會陰與膀胱每班追。
lines.en: Mr Chen: fixation and decompression, signals unchanged, neurogenic shock this evening managed per protocol. Kai: L5–S1 decompression, perineum and bladder checked every shift.

lines.zh: 阿凱從急診到開刀花了幾小時？
lines.en: Kai: how many hours from ER to theatre?

lines.zh: 電話到切皮不到四小時。
lines.en: Under four from the call to the knife.

lines.zh: 收到。那是一條被救回來的膀胱。
lines.en: Received. That is a bladder saved.

guide.zh: 范主治提起那個 MRI 時段
guide.en: Dr Fan brings up that MRI slot

lines.zh: 中午你本來想把阿凱的 MRI 排明天早上。
lines.en: At noon you wanted to book Kai's MRI for tomorrow morning.

lines.zh: 對。您說「不完全型是窗口」。
lines.en: I did. You said 'incomplete is the window'.

lines.zh: 記住：馬尾症候群的「明天」，常常就是「太晚」。
lines.en: Remember: in cauda equina, 'tomorrow' is very often 'too late'.

guide.en: The mentor's debrief

lines.zh: 今天三件事。陳先生的會陰檢查，你問出口了。
lines.en: Three things today. Mr Chen's perineal exam: you asked it out loud.

lines.zh: 阿凱的紅旗，你一通電話就認出來。神經性休克，你沒有灌水。
lines.en: Kai's red flags: you recognised them from one phone call. Neurogenic shock: you did not drown him.

lines.zh: 反射槌要還您嗎？
lines.en: Do you want the hammer back?

lines.zh: 明天再還。去吃飯。
lines.en: Tomorrow. Go and eat.

note.zh: 夜裡的腿無力：轉移性脊髓壓迫路徑啟動
note.en: Leg weakness at night: the cord compression pathway started

sub.zh: 乳癌病人背痛、兩腿越來越無力
sub.en: Breast cancer patient: back pain, legs getting weaker

lines.zh: 不好意思，醫師。腫瘤科 6 床，乳癌骨轉移，背痛一週，今晚站不起來，說腳麻到腰。
lines.en: Sorry to bother you, doctor. Oncology bed 6, breast cancer with bone spread, back pain for a week; tonight she cannot stand, numb up to the waist.

lines.zh: 癌症病史加背痛加腿無力——轉移性脊髓壓迫，先當它是。
lines.en: Cancer history plus back pain plus leg weakness: metastatic spinal cord compression until proven otherwise.

q.zh: 懷疑轉移性脊髓壓迫，今晚要做什麼？
q.en: Suspected metastatic spinal cord compression. What happens tonight?

options.zh: 平躺翻身法、依醫囑類固醇、一天內 MRI、叫主治
options.en: Flat with log roll, steroids per protocol, whole-spine MRI within 24 hours, call the attending

why.zh: 對。這是以小時計算的路徑：先保護脊椎，再找壓迫在哪裡，手術或放療由影像決定。
why.en: Right. This pathway runs in hours: protect the spine, find the compression, and let the imaging decide between surgery and radiotherapy.

why.zh: 能走進門診的人才能等門診。她今晚已經站不起來了。
why.en: Clinic is for people who can walk into clinic. She cannot stand tonight.

options.zh: 給止痛、鼓勵她下床走動
options.en: Analgesia and encourage her to walk

why.zh: 不穩定的脊椎加壓迫的脊髓，走動可能讓癱瘓變成永久。
why.en: An unstable spine and a compressed cord: walking can make the paralysis permanent.

guide.en: Go to the oncology ward and see her

lines.zh: 6 床平躺著，床頭放著孫子的畫。檢查：雙腿肌力下降、感覺平面在肚臍附近、肛門張力還在。
lines.en: Bed 6 lies flat, a grandchild's drawing at the bedside. Exam: both legs weak, a sensory level near the navel, anal tone preserved.

lines.zh: 阿姨，今晚先平躺，翻身我們幫您。藥依醫囑給了，明天一早做全脊椎 MRI，范主治會來看您。
lines.en: Tonight you stay flat and we turn you. The medicine per protocol is given; whole-spine MRI first thing, and Dr Fan will come and see you.

lines.zh: 她問還能不能參加孫子的畢業典禮。
lines.en: She asks if she'll make her grandson's graduation.

lines.zh: 我們今晚做的每一件事，都是為了那一天。
lines.en: Everything we do tonight is for that day.

sub.zh: 「6 床我看過了，MRI 排早上第一個。反射槌明天還。」
sub.en: 'Seen bed 6; MRI first slot in the morning. Hammer back tomorrow.'

lines.zh: 一排螺釘、一個馬尾、一顆慢心跳、一條脊髓。問出口，不要假設。
lines.en: A row of screws, a cauda equina, a slow heart, a spinal cord. Ask it out loud; never assume.

lines.zh: 值班結束。反射槌放在桌上，敲了最後一下。
lines.en: End of shift. The reflex hammer rests on the desk after one last tap.

sub.en: Ask it out loud; never assume
